issue.description:
## Motivation
This is a follow-up of #190134. Let's do it for real this time. Further resources:

* https://jira.suse.com/browse/MSQA-1010
* #190251#note-9

## Acceptance criteria
* **AC1:** SLE 16 maintenance product increments including kernel livepatches trigger openQA tests
* **AC2:** openQA approval is given if all tests pass
* **AC3:** As little as possible additional product-specific logic is present in qem-bot 
* **AC4:** No product-specific logic in openQA

## Suggestions
* Follow up with draft https://github.com/openSUSE/qem-bot/pull/235

Brought up the ticket in the daily. No need to rush this. We're on the same page here. Hence resetting the due date.

All pending PRs have been merged except the meta-data update/example: https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/metadata/-/merge_requests/1552

I [asked on Slack](https://suse.slack.com/archives/C08DC2SHABV/p1761232525306029) whether the repodiff computation could be improved but there's nothing new. I was only able to speed up my current approach so it now takes only 10 seconds locally (instead of 24). The API of Smelt is still not production ready.

When https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/metadata/-/merge_requests/1552 or a similar PR is merged we will have to configure using it in https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/-/pipeline_schedules/229/edit?id=229. Until then I'm not sure what to do because I haven't gotten any further feedback. We would probably just have to see how well it works in production to what's missing.

We'll have to wait until an increment with kernel livepatch updates happens to see whether it works for real.

Of course it would be nice if a PR with the configuration of all wanted kernel flavors would be merged by then (e.g. another PR based on https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/metadata/-/merge_requests/1552 extending it with additional flavors using `packages:`).
